title: Prescription Reading Rule: The Strip Rate a Liability Notice Covers
content:
A liability notice for test strips on the Blood Glucose Testing Supply Program covers the rate the next refill ships at, and that rate is read from the written orders for test strips on file.

**Rule.** The units per 30 days the notice covers are those of the program's newest written order for test strips when that order is not the order behind the program's latest strip refill and was signed within the last 30 days, the lower of the newest order's and that earlier order's units per 30 days when the newest order is not the order behind the latest strip refill and was signed more than 30 days ago, and otherwise those of the order behind the latest strip refill, because the notice covers the rate the next refill ships at.

- *Signed within the last 30 days* — an order date 30 days or fewer before today; an order date 31 or more days before today is signed more than 30 days ago.

| Newest order is the order behind the latest strip refill | Newest order's date | Rate covered |
|---|---|---|
| No | 30 days ago or later | the newest order's units per 30 days |
| No | 31 days ago or earlier | the lower of the newest order's and the earlier order's units per 30 days |
| Yes | any | the units per 30 days of the order behind the latest strip refill |

**Cases (hypothetical orders).** The latest strip refill rests on an order for 3 units per 30 days.

- A new order for 5 units per 30 days dated 12 days ago: the rate is 5.
- The same new order dated 45 days ago: the rate is the lower of 5 and 3, that is 3.
- A new order for 2 units per 30 days dated 45 days ago: the rate is 2.
- No order newer than the one behind the refill: the rate is 3.
